verdict.rationale: The evidence covers only Authenticator's own cloud backup and restore, which moves accounts between devices running Microsoft Authenticator, and export of autofill passwords. Neither is bulk import of OTP tokens from other authenticator apps. No documented import path exists, so this applicable portability axis is unmet.

support.subject: As a power user, I can import tokens in bulk from other authenticator apps instead of re-enrolling every account by hand
